tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (6.5:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: purple-primary
tokens.usage: Dusty purple evokes Victorian velvet, ║. Used as shadow/glow on `.filter-input:focus`, `.form-input:focus, .form-select:focus, .form-texta`.

tokens.name: purple-dark
tokens.usage: Deepened purple for maximum contrast and ║. Used as text on `.logo`, `.nav-main a:hover, .nav-main a:focus`, `.page-title`. 9.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: teal-accent
tokens.usage: Dark teal suggests Victorian libraries, ink ║.

tokens.name: bronze-accent
tokens.usage: Antique bronze for premium touches, ║. Used as text on `.page-header::before`. 3.7:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: bronze-light
tokens.usage: Warmed bronze for subtle highlights, ║. Used as text on `.footer-column h3`, `.footer-links a:hover, .footer-links a:focus`. 2.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: cream-primary
tokens.usage: Warm cream background evokes Victorian ║. Used as text on `.footer`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: cream-card
tokens.usage: Pure white for content cards, creating ║. Used as background on `th:hover`.

tokens.name: cream-dark
tokens.usage: Darkened cream for borders, subtle ║. Used as text on `.footer-links a`, `.footer-bottom`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Warm charcoal for text, 11.2:1 contrast on ║. Used as text on `body`, `.btn-tertiary:hover, .btn-tertiary:focus`, `.filter-input`. 13.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: gray-secondary
tokens.usage: Medium gray for supporting text, 7.4:1 ║. Used as text on `.nav-main a`, `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-label`. 6.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-change.positive`, `.form-success`. 4.3:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.
